visuals.purpose: Explain how a local burger price becomes an implied exchange-rate intuition.
visuals.source_data_requirement: The Economist Big Mac data if exact values are used; otherwise conceptual only.

visuals.concept: Work-hours ladder for a common product.
visuals.source_data_requirement: Final selected wage/product dataset before publication.

visuals.purpose: Distinguish myth, contested signal and useful cultural diagnostic.

visuals.purpose: Show dry bulk versus container freight scope difference.

visuals.purpose: Explain risk analogy without implying literal cigarette equivalence.
